```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

Load libraries:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

# Process reference data

Set user-defined values:

```{r}
project_id <- "LBBG_SCHIERMONNIKOOG"
end_date <- "2020-12-31 24:00:00"
```

## Read reference data

```{r}
path <- here::here("data", "processed", project_id, "movebank_ref_data.csv")
ref_data <- readr::read_csv(path)
```

## Process/filter reference data

```{r}
ref_data <-
  ref_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    `animal-comments` = NA_character_,
    `animal-life-stage` = dplyr::if_else(
      grepl("chick|juvenile", `animal-comments`, ignore.case = TRUE) |
      grepl("chick|juvenile", `deployment-comments`, ignore.case = TRUE),
      "juvenile",
      `animal-life-stage`
    ),
    `deployment-comments` = NA_character_,
    `deployment-end-type` = NA_character_,
    `manipulation-type` = dplyr::if_else(
      grepl("heart rate implant", `animal-comments`, ignore.case = TRUE),
      "manipulated-other",
      `manipulation-type`
    ),
    `behavior-according-to` = "https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23666749"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(`animal-life-stage` == "adult") |>
  dplyr::filter(`deploy-on-timestamp` <= as.POSIXct(end_date, tz = "UTC"))
```

## Write reference data

```{r}
readr::write_csv(
  ref_data,
  here::here("data", "processed", project_id, "movebank_ref_data.csv"),
  na = ""
)
```

# Process annotation data

## Read annotation data

```{r}
raw_annotations <- read_csv(here::here("data", "raw", "GULLIVER", "labeled_data.csv"))
ref_hg_texel <- read_csv(here::here("data", "processed", "HG_TEXEL", "movebank_ref_data.csv"))
ref_lbbg_texel <- read_csv(here::here("data", "processed", "LBBG_TEXEL", "movebank_ref_data.csv"))
```

Join annotations data with reference data:

```{r}
ref <-
  dplyr::bind_rows(ref_hg_texel, ref_lbbg_texel) |>
  dplyr::select(`tag-id`, `animal-id`, `alt-project-id`)
interim_annotations <- dplyr::left_join(raw_annotations, ref, by = dplyr::join_by(`tag-local-identifier` == `tag-id`))
```

Expect same number of records:

```{r}
nrow(raw_annotations) == nrow(interim_annotations)
```

## Transform data

Transform columns, only retain first of every 20 records:

```{r}
processed_annotations <-
  interim_annotations |>
  dplyr::arrange(`tag-local-identifier`, `timestamp`, `index`) |> # Sort
  dplyr::group_by(`alt-project-id`, `timestamp`) |>
  dplyr::slice(seq(1, n(), by = 20)) |> # Take first of very 20 records
  dplyr::mutate(
    .keep = "none",
    `tag-id` = as.character(`tag-local-identifier`),
    `animal-id` = as.character(`animal-id`),
    `timestamp` = format(timestamp + milliseconds(index * 50), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS3"), # Mimics format of gulliver-classify
    `behavioural-classification` = dplyr::recode_values(
      label,
      0 ~ "flap",
      1 ~ "exflap",
      2 ~ "soar",
      3 ~ "boat",
      4 ~ "float",
      5 ~ "stationary",
      6 ~ "walk",
      8 ~ "mixed",
      9 ~ "peck"
    ),
    `study-specific-measurement` = "human"
  ) |> dplyr::select(
    `alt-project-id`,
    `tag-id`,
    `animal-id`,
    `timestamp`,
    `behavioural-classification`,
    `study-specific-measurement`
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()
```

Split into two files:

```{r}
hg_texel_annotations <-
  processed_annotations |>
  dplyr::filter(`alt-project-id` == "HG_TEXEL") |>
  dplyr::select(-`alt-project-id`)
lbbg_texel_annotations <-
  processed_annotations |>
  dplyr::filter(`alt-project-id` == "LBBG_TEXEL") |>
  dplyr::select(-`alt-project-id`)
```

Expect same number of records:

```{r}
nrow(dplyr::bind_rows(hg_texel_annotations, lbbg_texel_annotations)) == nrow(processed_annotations)
```

## Write annotations data

```{r}
readr::write_csv(
  hg_texel_annotations,
  here("data", "processed", "HG_TEXEL", "movebank_beh_annotations.csv"),
  na = ""
)
readr::write_csv(
  lbbg_texel_annotations,
  here("data", "processed", "LBBG_TEXEL", "movebank_beh_annotations.csv"),
  na = ""
)
```
